column1: # GNI LAYER MAP - generation S107 (roadmap 3 row R3-3, check `declared layers wired`).

# every "N-layer" sentence on the public surface itself and demands N rows here.
# era LIVE = a declaration on the surface now; a LIVE row whose sentence leaves fails.
# era S68 = the S68 tree's two "7-layer" declarations, mapped to the S68 code at S107 so
# the replay (Test 1) judges that tree by evidence: `-` means no code implements the layer.
# evidence = a fragment that must occur in the symbol's own code, comments stripped.
